rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The generated return answers no to "Any residential clean energy property paid for in 2025, or a carryforward from 2024" (f5695.part1_any) yet gives a Part I cost ($3,285.00 on Form 5695 line 3, so line 15 figures to $985.50); the model used the line 15 amount "despite filer's 'no' answer". With no Part I property and no carryforward Part I is not completed and Schedule 3 line 5a has nothing to enter (i5695 p. 1, Purpose of Form, "Use Form 5695 to figure and take your residential energy credits"; f5695 p. 1, line 15, "Also include this amount on Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 5a"); the project enters zero. Project's working: line 5a = $0.00.
